What Happens at Our Events?

Think of it as a morning with purpose.
We start with coffee and informal networking, where we gently encourage you to sit and talk with someone new, step out of your comfort zone, and build meaningful conversations, even if you’re naturally introverted.
You’ll:
  • Meet inspiring women from all walks of entrepreneurship
  • Take great photos (yes, we love creating content!)
  • Share your story, pitch your idea, and exchange contacts
  • Build visibility and confidence in a safe, welcoming space
  • Get a feel for what our club and community are really about
We support women to be seen, heard, and celebrated.
And we love to see women exchange numbers, follow each other, and spark future collaborations, long after the event ends.
